Home / Privacy notice

Privacy notice

What the portal collects and who sees it

What we collect

Registration collects a contact name, work email, company name, company ZIP code and any referral code. Partner sections add certification documents and remittance details. The portal sets one session cookie so that forms can be submitted.

How it is used

The records office uses these details to validate registrations against the master vendor file, to issue credentials, and to pay awarded partners. Company names, award dates and contract values are published in award notices; contact details are not.

Procurement records are public records and may be released in response to a public records request, with personal contact details withheld where the law allows.

Questions

Write to the records office at vendors@lakefront-vn.example or call (847) 555-0137. Records are kept under the records retention policy.
